title.narrative: Bee Keeping and Vegetable Cultivation and Marketing Project

description.narrative: The Bee Keeping and Vegetable Cultivation and Marketing project is a Livelihoods and food security project contributing to alleviating the food insecurity circumstance of the beneficiaries, and capacitating them to earn income from the sales of their surplus commodities. The project is geared towards empowering beneficiaries to contribute economically to the welfare of their families and their communities. The overall goal of the project is to empower 80 women and 20 youths in the area of food and income security through Bee keeping and Vegetable production in the Serabu community. The modern organized production methods of honey and vegetables will maximize the production of both commodities. It means the increased yield can be used domestically thereby making the beneficiaries more food secure, and the surplus sold off for cash. The cash realised from the sale of the commodities will be used to grant soft loans to beneficiaries to take care of their personal problems, and some kept in a savings account that will earn interest. The project will target Serabu Self-Help Development Association, a group of women and youth who have come together to mobilise resources and their efforts to work together for honey production/food crop cultivation and marketing in order promote food security, and break out of the shackles of poverty in their community. The group comprises 120 direct beneficiaries, made up of 80 women and 40 youth.
